posts.caption:
Fight IQ isn't something you're born with.
It's something you build. Most of it outside sparring.

1. Watch fights on mute. Follow the feet.
2. Shadowbox with a plan. Pick an opponent and fight his habits.
3. Film your own rounds. Your habits show up on camera.
4. Ask why after every round. What worked, and why.
5. Drill reactions, not combos. He shows it, you answer it.
6. One counter a week. Use it until it's automatic.
7. Rest days are film days.

Save this for your next rest day.
